theorem: S_H,act^cov nonempty iff the hidden stress-energy realization family contains at least one nonzero member generated by an admitted covariant hidden action.
research_gain: For internal existence scouting, unique physical action selection is stronger than necessary. The immediate witness problem is only nonemptiness of the stress-active fiber.
guardrails: Does not select a physical action.

Does not identify Q nonidentity with stress-energy nonidentity.
